# Dynamic job family catalog

Plugins declare versioned River jobs with frozen payload schema and bounded retry/concurrency. Enqueue binds the live exact artifact; workers re-check the frozen contract before ExecuteJob.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Callable transport boundary

Host-brokered Enqueue and host-to-plugin ExecuteJob are the callable path. Cancel and Watch exist on the wire but currently return host.job_*_unavailable. Enqueue requires exact payload schema and live artifact admission.

Callable transport exists (see wire RPCs).

## Retry policies

- `none`, `bounded`, `exponential`

## Limits

| Limit | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| maxAttempts | 1..25 |
| concurrencyLimit | 1..16 (default 4) |
| retryDelaySeconds (bounded) | 1..3600 |
| retryDelaySeconds (none/exponential) | must be 0 |

## Manifest declaration fields

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `id` / `contractVersion` | Versioned job contract; `contractVersion` is `id@positiveVersion` |
| `name` | Stable job kind string used at enqueue / `JobRequest.job_kind` |
| `handler` | Required executable handler for `ExecuteJob` |
| `payloadSchema` | Versioned schema ref (`id@version`) |
| `retryPolicy` / `maxAttempts` / `retryDelaySeconds` / `concurrencyLimit` | Frozen execution policy |

`JobRequest.payload_version` is the **payload schema numeric version**, not `contractVersion`.

## Wire RPCs

| Direction | RPC | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin → host | `JobService.Enqueue` | Implemented (exact schema + admission) |
| Plugin → host | `JobService.Cancel` | Wire only; returns `host.job_cancel_unavailable` |
| Plugin → host | `JobService.Watch` | Wire only; returns `host.job_watch_unavailable` |
| Host → plugin | `ExecuteJob` | Implemented (progress stream) |

SDK: `pluginv2.JobRegistry` for execution dispatch; `Host.EnqueueJob` for versioned enqueue.
